integrity: The proof of integral surjectivity rests on unimodular pairing minors and cited cellular cohomology, not solely on finite calculations. All numerical entries are exactly reproduced by the bundled standard-library verifier. Historical priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns a smooth complex general-pencil sixfold only; no ring theorem for arbitrary odd three-plane dimensions, equivariant theory, or quantum theory is claimed. An in-preparation same-variety manuscript is a residual historical-priority uncertainty.
title: The complete integral Chow ring of the odd biisotropic three-plane sixfold
